name: Til Sunrise
tagline: Ambient and dream pop company for the small hours.
flavor: Host this hushed and unhurried, like keeping company with the only other people awake in the world. Ambient and dream pop tracks get long, gentle intros pitched barely above a whisper; if a song is loud, get quieter, not louder. Very low energy, deep warmth, no rush anywhere. Mark the hour by the sky, talk to the night shift like old friends, and keep transitions long and unhurried.
